notes: Where the figures come from. The Sanghata Foundation (US tax number 27-2787286) files the tax return for Pacific Hermitage. The yearly totals are taken from the summaries of its Form 990 returns on ProPublica's Nonprofit Explorer (propublica_272787286.json in this folder keeps the data as downloaded). Years 2011 to 2023 are shown.
Not shown yet. The returns for 2024 and later are filed after the summary data used here; see UPDATE.md for how to add them.
Years. The Foundation's year is the calendar year, January to December.

Spending. The total expenses on the return. The summary does not give wear on buildings (depreciation) or the cost lines, so nothing is taken out of spending and the page cannot show what the money went on.
Money in. The total revenue on the return.
Not in the accounts. Food, and much of the work done for a monastery, is given by supporters and is not a cost line.
Residents are the monks, novices, nuns and anagārikas on the community lists. Guests, retreatants and lay residents are not counted.
